notes.title: DEMO UPDATE 1.2
notes.content:
The demo has been updated (1.2)

[list]
[*] Added tutorials for crouching and jumping shots.
[*] Fixed the tutorial stage being too big.
[*] Add more set dresses to the tutorial stage to increase the level of details.
[*] Increase the level of detail in the tutorial background cube.
[*] Fixed infinite bullets.
[*] Added mouse sensitivity adjustment.
[*] Added sound volume adjustment.
[*] Added supports switching to windowed mode.
[*] Turned off colliders from enemy corpses
[*] Fixed an error where a Super Attack would not activate if performed immediately after a Baton Attack.
[*] Added a language selection screen when first starting the app.
[*] Added a screen to select how to play when the game is started for the first time.
[*] Fixed an error that caused a momentary drop in frames when each effect first appeared.
[*] Added tutorial for mouse and keyboard.
[*] Added color accents to aid gameplay (red)
[*] The door focus animation has been shortened a little.
[*] The boss appearance animation has been shortened a little.
[*] Added CRT effect to Sekiguchi-san.
[*] Added invert Y settings.
[/list]

*There was a glitch with the SURVIVAL camera, which has now been fixed.(2024.12.24)

notes.title: RX10-40 DEV NEWS 01
notes.content:
Thank you for following the RX10-40 community! 
I'll be posting various updates, event participation reports, news, and more here from now on.

I released the DEMO earlier than planned in November, and currently over 1,000 people have played it. 
I found many issues that needed to be fixed, so I'm currently working on updating the DEMO.

Here are the planned fixes.

[list]
[*] Add tutorials for crouching and shooting, and jumping and shooting.
[*] Fix the tutorial stage being too large.
[*] Add more set dressing to the tutorial stage to increase visual detail.
[*] Improve or dirty up the background cubes in the tutorial stage to add more visual information.
[*] Fix the bug where bullets can be infinitely picked up.
[*] Lower the mouse sensitivity slightly, as it's currently too high, and eventually make it adjustable.
[*] Disable the collider immediately after defeating an enemy.
[*] Fix a camera error.
[*] Super attack immediately after a baton attack fails. so fix it.
[*] Add a language selection screen at first launch.
[*] Fix a bug where effects cause a momentary frame drop the first time they appear.
[*] Add tutorial for mouse and keyboard.
[*] Add accent colors to improve the game play visibility
[/list]

I think the update period will be between December and January.
Also, if there's anything that you think should be fixed, please feel free to start a thread.
